operators.name: torch_sum_dim1
semantics: Corresponds to torch.sum(x, dim=1) with keepdim=False.
Reduces the channel axis (axis 1) of input shape [16,3,4096,4096].
Output tensor has shape [16,4096,4096], with output[b,h,w] = x[b,0,h,w] + x[b,1,h,w] + x[b,2,h,w].
No bias, no broadcasting, no scaling.
Input and output are CUDA float32 tensors; output is allocated by extension and returned.

operators.name: torch_argmax_all
semantics: Corresponds to torch.argmax(x) with no arguments, reducing over all elements.
Returns a scalar 0-dimensional tensor of dtype int64 containing the index of the maximum value in the flattened tensor.
If multiple equal maxima, returns the first (smallest index) occurrence as in PyTorch.
Operates on CUDA float32 input; output is CUDA int64 scalar.
Output shape [16, 4096, 4096], dtype float32, device cuda:0.
Result is sum of three channel slices.
Computes argmax over all elements of sum_result.
Output is a scalar tensor dtype int64, device cuda:0.
Index is with respect to flattened (C-order) layout of sum_result.
